title: Pickled Patriarchs Elixir
description: A surreal dark fantasy painting depicts a glowing green crystal ball on a dripping altar containing the head of a stern man. To the right stands a large green mosaic head with purple tiles, while above, three green-skinned women with snake-like hair and lightning bolts emerge from a stormy sky. The altar holds lit candles, potion bottles labeled with hot dogs and text, scattered pills, and ominous scrolls.
